description: Invite teammates (by email) to the TestChimp organization so they can access this project. Each invitee joins as a Viewer and gets a sign-up email. The caller must be an org admin: the OAuth user (hosted MCP / QA bot connector), or with a project API key the user in TESTCHIMP_USER_ID (sent as the user-id header). Returns a per-email outcome (INVITED, ALREADY_MEMBER, ALREADY_INVITED, FAILED with failureReason) and teamSettingsUrl for role changes / seats. Only call with emails the user explicitly confirmed.

emails.description: Teammate email addresses to invite (max 20 per call).
